banned.injection-suspect: came from an untrusted outside message

consequence_templates.approve: {risk} If you confirm, I go ahead: {what}
consequence_templates.approve:draft-outbound: {risk} If you confirm, the message goes out exactly as drafted. Haven't read it? It's on this item's Telegram card — open that first.
consequence_templates.approve:escalation: Nothing runs yet — this marks it as yours to decide. The First Mate brings it to you in Telegram to settle.
consequence_templates.approve:need: {risk} If you confirm, the cabinet gets this permission.
consequence_templates.later: Nothing happens now — it comes back at the next briefing.
consequence_templates.no: Nothing happens — I record the no and stop suggesting it.
consequence_templates.no:escalation: The First Mate settles it and tells you what it chose.
consequence_templates.no:need: The cabinet does not get this permission.

copy.details_typing: Prefer typing? Send this in Telegram:
copy.footer_hint: Tap a button to decide — or answer on the item's Telegram message.
copy.masthead_dark_sub: All clear — your team is handling the rest. ✅
copy.masthead_unknown: I can't tell you what's waiting.
copy.masthead_unknown_sub: My list is not current, so this is NOT an all-clear. Check Telegram.
copy.no_buttons: To decide this one, answer on its Telegram message.
copy.overflow_note: more waiting — I've asked the First Mate to sort them out.
copy.ritual_hint: To say yes, sign it off in Telegram — tap 'Open in Telegram'.

kind_risk_defaults.outcome-ratification: This sets the goal your team steers by — nothing runs by itself.

messages.bad_request: I couldn't read that request — reload the page and try again.
messages.bad_verb: That choice isn't available for this item.
messages.bridge_fail: Something went wrong recording your decision — nothing was done. Try again, or answer in Telegram.
messages.csrf: That request didn't come from your own dashboard page — reload and try again.
messages.decided: Already decided — nothing more to do here.
messages.expired_token: That confirmation expired — start again from the card.
messages.gone: This one is no longer waiting — it may already be decided.
messages.journal_warn: Heads up: this attempt may be missing from the journal.
messages.no_session: You're not signed in — open the dashboard sign-in page first.
messages.not_here: This one can't be decided from here right now — answer on its Telegram message.
messages.rate_limited: Too many decisions too fast — wait a moment and try again.
messages.replay: That confirmation was already used — start again from the card.
messages.ritual: This one needs the sign-off ritual in Telegram — tap 'Open in Telegram'.
messages.stale: This one changed since you loaded the page — here's the fresh version.
messages.stale_census: My list is out of date right now — try again in a minute, or answer in Telegram.

no_return_worst_cases: a message reaches a human outside the machine

results.approved_delivery_failed: Your approval is recorded, but the follow-through hit an error — the First Mate will finish it.
results.deferred: Parked — it comes back at the next briefing.
results.denied: Okay — I won't do that without asking.

risk_default: If you approve, I go ahead with it.
risk_default_ceiling: This is a high-caution change — double-check before saying yes.

risk_sentences.a Chair judgment lands without you: If you don't answer, the First Mate will decide this one.
risk_sentences.a capability/resource is granted: This gives the cabinet a new tool or access.
risk_sentences.a ceiling-class artifact ships (prod/sec: This touches production or secrets — highest caution.
risk_sentences.a message reaches a human outside the ma: This sends a message to a real person outside.
risk_sentences.a reversible internal artifact needs und: Worst case: an internal change gets undone. Low risk.
risk_sentences.a standing grant widens org authority: This gives the cabinet a lasting new permission.
risk_sentences.a wrong approve amends the germline plan: This changes the cabinet's own core rules — hardest to undo.
risk_sentences.the Chair is holding a judgment open: The First Mate is waiting on you for this.
risk_sentences.unclassified chain — treated as low, gat: I couldn't sort this one, so it waits for you. Low risk.

undo_templates.approve: Undo: most changes can be pulled back from the receipt — tap ↩ Undo there.
undo_templates.approve:ceiling: Hard to undo once done — double-check before you confirm.
undo_templates.approve:no-return: Once this is done it can't be pulled back from here — read it once more before you confirm.
undo_templates.later: It comes back on its own — nothing to undo.
undo_templates.no: You can always re-open it from its Telegram message.
